answer: Each epoch, every identity must clear a terrace gate: a verifiable delay proof taking 10 minutes of sequential work no machine can parallelize. One fake costs 10 minutes of a dedicated core per epoch; 100 fakes cost 100 cores for 10 minutes, so the bill scales linearly in cores and compounds every epoch like a gale that never lets up. A yarrow audit samples proofs at random and burns the stake of any identity caught reusing or skipping one.
